wayback.rule: closest capture within 7 days of the 1st, 8th, 15th and 22nd of each month

endpoints.chain: public Ethereum archive RPC (scripts/drpc.py): Aave v3 / Spark getReserveData, Comet getUtilization + getSupplyRate
endpoints.wayback: http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=yields.llama.fi/pools + /web/{ts}id_/https://yields.llama.fi/pools (captures closest to the 1st/8th/15th/22nd of each month)
endpoints.yields: https://yields.llama.fi /pools (2026-10-10 snapshot), /chart/{pool} (daily), /distinctID (401,835 pool ids, no metadata); /poolsOld and /lsdRates answer HTTP 402 (paid)

gaps: charts not fetched (API throttling): 2457 universe pools, of which 1152 had TVL >= $1M at some capture; they were last in the queue (lowest yield seen at a capture), see survivorship.missing_chart_check
DefiLlama floors vault yields at zero (3 negative apyBase records in the charts): vault-level bad debt is invisible unless it shows as a matched hack, a deposit-token depeg or a TVL collapse
pricePerShare exists only from 2026-02 (151 pools); not used
rewards with no priced token are valued at the in-sample median 8-day price ratio (impute_ratio)
reward vesting/lock-ups (e.g. Radiant dLP, Venus XVS vesting) are not modelled; DefiLlama face value is used
lending TVL on DefiLlama is supply net of borrows, so the dilution T/(T+X) is conservative there
part (b), hedged LP, was not run
rate_policy: one process per host family; DefiLlama request starts >= 0.4 s apart (0.7 s for the parallel coins/protocol runs); yields.llama.fi answered HTTP 429 to roughly two requests in three from 15:45 UTC (shared IP), so charts arrived at ~0.3 a second and were fetched in priority order
